title: Sunset Sea-Kayaking Excursion on St. Lawrence River
includes: Equipment: sea kayak, paddle, spray skirt, mandatory safety equipment
Kayak clothing: wetsuit, water shoe, waterproof jacket, glove
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Bring a swimsuit (for the wetsuit in May-June-October)
Please dress in athletic summer wear and bring water, lunch and snacks
Age restriction: must be at least 10 years old to participate
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
If canceled due to bad weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date or full refund
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the St. Lawrence River on a sunset sea-kayaking tour for a memorable and unique experience. Paddle to the rhythm of the tide and current. With easy-to-follow techniques and sea-kayak equipment provided, this 2.5-hour tour is suitable for beginners and experts alike. Bring your sense of adventure!
